author: D. L. Darling
title: Lake Bluff Library announces possible internet interruptions during fiberoptic upgrade
text:
← Back to the wire
Lake Bluff Library announces possible internet interruptions during fiberoptic upgrade
Lake Bluff Library will upgrade its internet connection on Oct. 19, possibly causing temporary outages. Patrons planning computer or Wi-Fi use should prepare for brief service interruptions.
The Lake Bluff Library announced on Oct. 14 that it will transition to fiberoptic internet on Monday, Oct. 19, with work scheduled to begin before business hours. The library said it is coordinating the switch to minimize disruptions for patrons.
According to the announcement, intermittent internet outages may occur during the transition process. The library advised patrons who plan to use computers or Wi-Fi that day to prepare for possible interruptions.
"We are coordinating the switch to minimize disruptions, but intermittent internet outages may occur," the library said in its statement. "If you plan to use the Library’s computers or Wi-Fi that day, please prepare for possible interruptions. Thank you for your patience as we complete this upgrade."
The upgrade aims to improve overall connectivity and service quality at the facility by moving from current infrastructure to a fiberoptic system.
Patrons are encouraged to plan accordingly and monitor updates from the library regarding completion of the upgrade.
